title: Dataset Manifest Schema
description: Meta-schema for dataset manifests that govern future immutable datasets. Every dataset used in the MSTR/BTC research tracks must have a manifest conforming to this schema. The manifest records provenance, schema binding, quality results, immutability evidence, and point-in-time safety. No dataset may be used in any signal, model, or backtest without a validated manifest. In Phase 18B: collection_authorized is false, execution_eligible is false.

dataset_id.description: Unique dataset identifier. e.g. mstr-daily-bars-ibkr-v1, btc-spot-daily-coingecko-v1.

dataset_version.description: Dataset version. Must change when data is updated. Immutable versions are never overwritten.

dataset_state.description: Dataset lifecycle state. PROPOSED = planned but not collected. COMPLETE = collection complete, data frozen. FROZEN = immutable and ready for backtest. QUARANTINED = quality issues detected.

research_track.description: Research track assignment. A dataset belongs to exactly one track.

schema_file.description: Path to the governing schema file. e.g. docs/strategy-proposals/data-governance/EQUITY_BAR_SCHEMA_v0_1.json.

schema_version.description: Schema version the data conforms to.

schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the governing schema file at the time of dataset creation. Establishes an immutable schema→data binding.

provider_governance_version.description: Version of the provider governance document in effect.

provider_governance_sha256.description: SHA-256 of MSTR_BTC_PROVIDER_GOVERNANCE_v0_1.json at the time of dataset creation.

quality_policy_version.description: Version of the data quality policy in effect.

quality_policy_sha256.description: SHA-256 of MSTR_BTC_DATA_QUALITY_POLICY_v0_1.json at the time of dataset creation.

provider_role_ids.description: Provider role identifiers used to collect this dataset. e.g. ['primary_equity_bar'] or ['primary_btc_spot', 'fallback_btc_spot'].

instrument_ids.description: Canonical instrument identifiers included in this dataset.

interval_or_event_scope.description: Bar interval (e.g. '1day') or event scope descriptor (e.g. 'all_mstr_corporate_events').

earliest_event_timestamp_utc.description: Earliest event_timestamp_utc in the dataset in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'.

record_count.description: Total number of records in the dataset.

quarantined_record_count.description: Number of records quarantined (present but excluded from signal/model use).

duplicate_record_count.description: Number of duplicate records detected and excluded.

source_revision_count.description: Number of records where revision_number > 1 (i.e. corrections or amendments exist).

raw_data_immutable.description: Must be true for a raw dataset. Raw records are never modified after initial ingestion.

derived_data.description: True if this dataset contains derived/computed data (features, signals, labels) rather than raw source records. Derived datasets must reference parent datasets.

parent_dataset_ids.description: When derived_data is true, the dataset_ids of the source datasets. Required for derived datasets.

parent_dataset_hashes.description: When derived_data is true, the content_sha256 values of the parent datasets. Required for derived datasets.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the complete dataset content (deterministic serialization of all records). Used for immutable content addressing.

deterministic_manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of this manifest (excluding this field). Computed the same way as Phase 18A/18B governance manifests.

point_in_time_safe.description: True if the dataset passes point-in-time validation: no record has available_at_utc later than its event_timestamp_utc, and no lookahead bias exists. Must be true for backtest use.

lookahead_detected.description: Must be false for an acceptable dataset. True indicates that future information may have leaked into the dataset (e.g. a split-adjusted price used before the split was announced).

quality_gate_state.description: Quality gate state. NOT_CHECKED = quality engine has not yet evaluated this dataset. PASSED = all quality checks passed. FAILED = one or more HARD_FAIL rules triggered. WAIVED = failure waived by human review.

collection_authorized.description: Must be false in Phase 18B. Collection authorization requires explicit human approval and governance state transition beyond SCHEMA_CONTRACT_READY.

execution_eligible.description: Must be false. No dataset in Phase 18B is executable.

created_utc.description: Timestamp when this manifest was created.

created_by.description: Agent or process that created this manifest.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about this dataset version.

raw_data_immutable_true.description: Raw datasets must be immutable. Derived datasets (derived_data == true) may reference mutable computation but the raw source must remain immutable.

collection_authorized_false_phase18b.description: Collection is not authorized in Phase 18B.

lookahead_detected_false.description: Lookahead bias is unacceptable. Dataset must not contain future information.

schema_sha256_matches_file.rule: schema_sha256 must match the SHA-256 of the schema_file at manifest creation time.

provider_governance_sha256_matches.rule: provider_governance_sha256 must match the SHA-256 of the provider governance document at manifest creation time.

quality_policy_sha256_matches.rule: quality_policy_sha256 must match the SHA-256 of the quality policy document at manifest creation time.

derived_has_parents.rule: IF derived_data == true THEN parent_dataset_ids IS NOT NULL AND length(parent_dataset_ids) >= 1

deterministic_manifest_hash_self_consist.rule: deterministic_manifest_hash must match the hash of the manifest with that field excluded.

content_sha256_matches_content.rule: content_sha256 must match the deterministic hash of the actual dataset content.

timestamps_rfc3339_utc_z.rule: All timestamp fields must end with 'Z'.

no_broker_fields.rule: No broker IDs, order IDs, account IDs, execution IDs, approval IDs, H1 fields, credentials, tokens, or endpoint URLs.
